cases.name: yggdrasil-shake-parity
cases.doc: HEAVY (gate behind --heavy): run (yggdrasil.shake ["tests/fib.shen"] OUT) on each host from the yggdrasil repo and assert the produced kernel.kl + yggdrasil.manifest are BYTE-IDENTICAL across all available hosts. The user KL (fib.kl) differs only by gensym counter, so it is NOT asserted. Hosts are driven WITHOUT -q (shen-lua/shen-rust would otherwise silence pr -> zero-byte artefacts). Set $BIFROST_YGGDRASIL_DIR to relocate the repo; if absent, the case is SKIPPED, not failed.
